Nvidia Faces Governance Overhang: Jensen Huang's Affair Admission Sparks Board Probe, Analysts Warn Of Leadership Risks

stories.summary: In out-of-hours trading on Monday morning (Asian time), Nvidia was quoted around $180.30, about 3.4% below Friday's $186.64 close, on Hyperliquid perpetual futures and the Blue Ocean overnight system. explainer.meaning: A Senate vote to end debate on a bill; it needs 60 of 100 votes, so it shows whether a bill has enough support to pass.

stories.headline: Final Senate permitting text keeps the rule letting states make data centres pay for grid upgrades

impacts.why: Heatmap reports the bill's core transmission planning, cost-sharing and federal backstop siting mechanisms are kept, with a one-year state-first wait added.

sources.title: The Last-Minute Changes to the Senate Permitting Deal, Explained

stories.summary: Ahead of Monday's 60-vote test (cloture) vote, senators released a final manager's amendment to the permitting bill. It keeps the ratepayer-protection programme that lets states and utilities charge data centres for the system upgrades they cause and adds an Energy Department help programme for local communities. Transmission developers must now go through states for a year before using federal backstop siting, and some Southeastern utilities get exemptions from a combined planning mandate.
